strings.name: Liu Chuanzhi
strings.role: Lenovo founder · Honorary chair of Legend Holdings
strings.summary: Liu moved from research into entrepreneurship, helping a team develop Lenovo’s computer business and Legend Holdings’ investment and management systems. His career spans international expansion, governance changes and management training. He left Lenovo’s board in 2011 and announced his retirement as Legend Holdings chair in 2019. His honorary positions should be distinguished from current operational management.
